programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle.

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: LITTLE TRAIN TITIPO, NEWBORN IN CHOO CHOO TOWN, JUST PASSED HIS DRIVING EXAM AND IS READY TO WORK IN THE RAILWAY VILLAGE. ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer is a variety show that provides entertainment and education. Abang l will invite viewers to play and learn things that are appropriate for his age, with different topics in each episode. Abang L's funny antics, charm, and energy will bring this program to life. The articulate Abang L will ask questions to people around him. He will also try out several professions with the aim of educating viewers about each role.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (KATURI DAN SAHABAT KECILNYA)
programme.desc: MEET THE KATURI FAMILY, A PHEW FAMILY - A MOTHER BIRD AND HER FOUR ADORABLE CHICKENS, LIVE A QUIET LIFE IN THEIR PEACEFUL FOREST HOME. BUT, WHEN THEIR FOREST IS BULLDOZED TO MAKE SOMETHING NEW, THIS FEATHERED FAMILY IS FORCED TO MOVE TO THE BIG CITY! BUT ONCE THEY ARRIVE, THE UNEXPECTED HAPPENS AND THE CHICKENS ARE SEPARATED FROM THEIR MOTHER!

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS IS A POKEMON ANIME SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF A POKEMON TRAINER NAMED ASH KETCHUM AND HIS FRIEND, GOH. THEY JOURNEY ACROSS VARIOUS POKEMON REGIONS TO CHASING THEIR DREAMS. IN THEIR ADVENTURES, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, BATTLE AGAINST POWERFUL TRAINER, AND LEARN MANY NEW THINGS ABOUT POKEMON. THE STORY FOCUS ON THE FRIENDSHIP, ADVENTURE, AND CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT BRINGING BY THEIR JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF POKEMON.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Watch the excitement of Momo, Cici, Blu, and the gang. Accompanying your growth and development, Indonesia's golden generation for the world!

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES is a Russian animated series that follows the adventures of the Fixies, tiny creatures who live inside electronic devices. They secretly repair everyday technological problems while teaching viewers about science and technology in a fun and engaging way. The series is designed to help children learn about electronic devices and the importance of properly maintaining them.

JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN

They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING

We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

He will also try out several professions with the aim of educating viewers about each role.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION

THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.desc: In Episode 1, The Case for the Prosecution, the documentary reexamines the high-profile trial of British au pair Louise Woodward. programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 5
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier follows Kang Seong-jae, a young man from a humble background who joins the army after losing his father. Although he excels during training, he is assigned to work in the military kitchen due to his experience helping at his father's food truck. One day, a mysterious virtual interface appears before him and begins assigning cooking-related missions. As he completes each challenge, his culinary skills improve dramatically, earning the respect of fellow soldiers and superiors alike. Alongside the humor and camaraderie of military life, Seong-jae gradually uncovers hidden secrets connected to his father's death. Blending military comedy, fantasy, and food-themed storytelling, the series delivers an uplifting tale of perseverance, friendship, and self-discovery.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.desc: Hidden away from France's main transport routes, the Drôme region is home to spectacular valleys, charming villages, and a rich cultural heritage. Drôme, la France au naturel takes viewers on a journey through territories such as the Baronnies Provençales, the Diois, and the Rhône Valley around Montélimar, where nature and tradition coexist in harmony. From lavender fields and lime blossom festivals to vineyards and historic landscapes, the documentary showcases the region's biodiversity, local customs, and authentic way of life, offering an immersive portrait of one of France's most beautiful natural destinations.

As the investigation progresses, Ève must navigate a world of ambition, jealousy, and betrayal while trying to prove her innocence. Blending crime mystery with psychological drama and a nostalgic atmosphere, the film explores the darker side of fame and the fragile nature of trust.

As the miles pass, the journey becomes more than a physical adventure; it transforms into a deeply personal quest for healing, friendship, and acceptance. Blending gentle comedy with emotional drama, the film celebrates resilience and the enduring power of human connection.

programme.desc: "Uang Kaget Lagi" is an old program repackaged with a new concept, featuring crazy rich people who will test someone's kindness before giving them a sum of money that they have to spend fast

programme.title: Katanya S1 E1
programme.desc: A house with position on a T-junction creates a negative aura and brings bad luck to the residents of the house. The strategic location of a building is usually judged by the easy access of the highway or various major locations, such as close to shopping centers and health facilities. However, many people also still believe that feng shui also plays important role in determining the strategic values of a building. We often see an empty house or building in a certain corner, and people usually call a house like that "tusuk sate" (house on a T-junction). Believe it or not, Ben will try to find out whether a house at the T-junction position really brings bad luck to the owner.

programme.title: Katanya S1 E2
programme.desc: Don't go outside the house at dusk, or you'll be kidnapped by demons! This is an old-age warning from parents, and it makes soccer fields, parks, and children's playground empty at 6 pm every day. It is said that when Maghrib (dusk time) arrives, there is a change in natural color spectrum, in sync with the frequency of jinn and demons, namely red color spectrum. Demons and jinns have a resonance with colors of nature at Maghrib time; therefore, at this time that they are at their most powerful condition, and be able to haunt other living creatures. This episode will try to prove such myth. Will Ben be kidnapped by demons while playing outside at dusk time?

programme.title: Katanya S1 E3
programme.desc: As a child, Ani often saw butterflies flying beautifully in her front yard. Usually after seeing a butterfly, she would faithfully wait on the terrace. It's unclear what to expect, but Ani believes her father's words that if there are butterflies flying in front of the house, it means some special guests will visit the house. Now Ani has grown up and she is still curious about such butterfly myth. Because from Ani's experience, not even once was there a special guest visiting them when she saw a butterfly in front of her house.

programme.title: Katanya S1 E4
programme.desc: It is said that tuyul first appeared in the 1890s, but the "term" tuyul only became popular around 1929. Tuyul takes the form of a bald demon, resembling adults and toddlers, and tuyul is considered to have been born due to social inequality between rich and poor people. This bald-headed demonic creature has a specific task, namely taking other people's property or money without being caught or seen by the owner. Until now, there are still some people who want to get rich instantly by using tuyul services.

programme.title: Katanya S1 E5
programme.desc: According to G.A Wilken, a well-known western scholar, in prehistoric nations in Polynesian archipelago, Central Asia and Southeast Asia, there was a ritual that put the emphasis in cutting certain parts of the body, such as hair, teeth, piercing (punching) ears, tatuage (scarring the skin), to be used as a sacrificial ceremony to the ancestor spirits. Self-torture within certain limit was considered a valuable sacrifice in religion, including Tapa Brata meditation. Tooth-cutting ceremony is done in Balinese culture, but it is also performed in Jakarta. It is facilitated by the Pedanda in Jakarta. Its function is to help young men and women who are growing up. They are obliged to perform such sacred ceremony.

programme.title: Katanya S1 E6
programme.desc: When humans are faced with something that they do not expect, they will definitely try to avoid or eliminate these obstacles by all means. What would you do when facing an unexpected pregnancy? Many people believe that young pineapple and soda drink can kill the unborn baby, but is this really proven to solve the problem?

programme.title: Katanya S1 E7
programme.desc: We are born, grew up, evolved in a country that upholds the rules and laws designed by the government. Even for marriage matters, we have regulations that must be obeyed by the community; otherwise the citizens would be subject to legal sanctions, and the one which is no less bad: social sanctions. It is said that interfaith marriages in Indonesia are illegal. Is it true that the belief in claiming it illegal is still relevant to be upheld today?

programme.title: Katanya S1 E8
programme.desc: Career, health, marriage, and death, are things that we cannot predict. More and more people nowadays, who are on the brink of desperation, use the services of tarot reader to see their future. In fact, by nature, tarot cards are used to see a person's personal sides and explore themselves, not to predict the future. It is this misunderstanding that often makes tarot seem like an act of polytheism, and it is judged to precede the Supreme Creator.

programme.title: Katanya S1 E9
programme.desc: Mental health has become a hot topic of discussion and gained a lot of attention lately, even though the research of this matter has been around for a long time. Especially there is a stigma in Indonesia, which states that we are always required to be strong, resilient, emotionally tough; and we are taught not to think much about our own mental health. This can lead to prolonged depression and may trigger mental illness. Again, here in Indonesia, individuals who have mental illnesses are easily labeled insane. and they cannot be cured. Is it true that mental illness cannot be cured?

programme.title: Katanya S1 E10
programme.desc: The definition of love is certainly diverse. The language of affection has many forms. Love is abstract and cannot be generalized. Hate is spread, violence is shown, harassment is tolerated to the fullest, while hugging scenes in movies are censored by KPI and LSF. Giving farewell kisses are considered excessive, and holding your lover or friend will make people talking about you non-stop . Will Indonesia continue to be a country that prides itself on violence more than love?
